out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Two insecticide spray containers stored on shelf, next to food, in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CORRECTED DURING THER INSPECTION.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Non-commercial insecticides were observed in the facility, being use for pest control.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. They are intended for household use only. Remover from premises immedaitely. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Steamed white rice = 61F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Rice discarded.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: 3 Compartment Sink Required
violations.observation: There is no 3-compartment sink located in the establishment.This sink is in. Disrepair. The piping on two of the three compartments are leaking profusely, when in use, preventing the proper use of the sink as required.
violations.corrective_action: A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Repair this sink within the next 10 days.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the piping at the 3-compartment sink are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior surfaces of the ice machine were observed ed to be soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: whole mil48F, half & Half=53F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.CORRECTED. BOTH ITEMS WERE DISCARDED DURING THE INSPECTION

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Flour, sugar, sauces in squeeze bottles, spices.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. An employee was observed def wearing a watch while handling food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED AT HAND SINK ON COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC RESTOCKED PAPER TOWELS.
